item.title: En Líbano, la crisis económica y la inflación asfixian a los hogares
item.description: La crisis económica que golpea al Líbano desde 2019 vuelve a agravarse. La reanudación de la guerra entre Israel y Hezbolá frenó la frágil recuperación registrada el año pasado. El Banco Mundial prevé que la economía libanesa se contraiga un 6,4% este año, mientras la inflación rondaría el 17,5%. En este contexto, la desigualdad se profundiza y atraviesa todos los ámbitos de la vida cotidiana, desde los hogares hasta las empresas y los hábitos de consumo. Reportaje de Serge Berberi y Renée Davis para France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: China castiga a Mbappé: el precio de un polémico meme sobre Mao
item.description: Una broma sobre un meme ha desencadenado una crisis entre Kylian Mbappé y China. El delantero francés reaccionó en una entrevista a una imagen manipulada que lo representaba como Mao Zedong, antiguo líder chino al que aludió como un dictador. La polémica ha tenido consecuencias comerciales y deportivas: tres empresas chinas han roto sus acuerdos con el futbolista y la televisión estatal ha suspendido las emisiones de LaLiga en las que salga el galo. item.title: Ireland fall behind in series after Namibia defeat
item.description: Ireland fall 2-1 behind in their five-match ODI series against Namibia as they lose by 63 runs in the third meeting between the sides. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: McInnes admits feeling 'guilt' over leaving Hearts for Rangers
item.description: Rangers manager Derek McInnes admits feeling "guilt" about leaving Hearts for Ibrox in the summer and accepts the rough reception that could come his way when he returns to Tynecastle on Wednesday. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Simpler, cheaper hybrid V8s proposed for next F1 rules
item.description: Formula 1's next engine regulations are set to introduce V8 turbo hybrid engines that are simplified and less expensive compared to the existing rules. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: How have 'best team north or south of border' last season lost six in a row?
item.description: BBC Scotland analyses Motherwell's plight to find out what's not clicking at Fir Park. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: How Kane's Ballon d'Or win could boost the Bundesliga
item.description: Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or win not only ended a 25-year wait for an English winner of the award but also saw a Bundesliga player win it for the first time since 1996. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Outrage after cops are called for 3-year-old who is ‘too good at soccer’
item.description: The coach had called the police to request that the boy’s parents be removed because they were causing a disturbance Fuente: The Independent - World.

item.title: Ballon d'Or in London - the most chaotic ever?
item.description: It was the first time the Ballon d'Or had been held in London in its 70-year history - but the event was not plain sailing. BBC Sport assesses a chaotic night. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Milne out for season as Hearts' injury woes continue
item.description: Heart of Midlothian defender Harry Milne's season is over after he sustains an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury, head coach Wouter Vrancken confirms. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Williams loses again - to opponent 28 years younger
item.description: Former world number one Venus Williams, 46, loses for the 16th match in a row as she is beaten by an opponent 28 years younger. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Wales call up in-form Page after Dyer injury blow
item.description: Wales release Rio Dyer from their Nations Championship squad after hamstring injury, with Scarlets wing Macs Page added for November's games. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Mbappé se ríe de un meme donde le comparan con Mao Zedong y China veta la emisión de LaLiga dentro del país
item.description: El 16 de octubre, el Real Madrid pedía la dimisión de Javier Tebas , presidente de LaLiga, con un comunicado. Un viernes como otro cualquiera, pensamos quienes seguimos con más aburrimiento que interés el cruce de declaraciones y afrentas entre el club y la organización de la competición doméstica. Apenas 11 días después ha sido Kylian Mbappé, estrella madridista, el que ha dado un golpe a LaLiga. Uno muy duro que se ha llevado por delante también sus propios contratos de patrocinio. Uno que nos demuestra, una vez más, lo desconocedores que somos de la cultura china. ¿Qué ha pasado? 26 de… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: Alberto de la Torre

item.title: England out of tri-series after Sri Lanka beat Pakistan
item.description: Sri Lanka thrash Pakistan by eight wickets to end England's hopes of reaching Saturday's tri-series final. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: La hazaña de Charlyn Corral, la jugadora que hizo historia para México al ganar el Balón de Oro a la mejor delantera
item.description: Charlyn Corral ofreció un emotivo discurso en el que expresó cuán feliz se sentía de “ser la primera mexicana" en recibir un reconocimiento en la prestigiosa gala del fútbol mundial. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane delivers emotional acceptance speech
item.description: Harry Kane became the first Englishman in 25 years to win the Ballon d’Or on Monday. Kane scored 73 goals for club and country last campaign and smashed scoring records at the World Cup, where he captained England to a third-place finish. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Carrick to stay in charge of Man Utd for Chelsea game
item.description: Michael Carrick will remain in charge of Manchester United for their trip to Chelsea this weekend. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Unattached Coleman 'edging towards' retirement
item.description: Former Everton defender Seamus Coleman says he is contemplating retiring from football but does not "want to completely draw a line in the sand" on his career. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: England face 'do or die' World Cup game with Samoa
item.description: England's final group game of the 2026 women's Rugby League World Cup is "do or die", according to coach Stuart Barrow. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Lawrie, 15, eyes £501,000 live TV win over Littler
item.description: Mitchell Lawrie, 15, one of 24 amateur players taking part in live TV special Beat Luke Littler, has his sights on a £501,000 bullseye should he beat the world darts champion. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Abhishek hits 35-ball ton as India hammer New Zealand
item.description: Abhishek Sharma's 113 from 38 balls helps India chase a target of 199 in just 13.2 overs against New Zealand. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Eagles slump to fifth straight defeat against the Cowboys
item.description: The Dallas Cowboys beat the Philadelphia Eagles 38-21 to hand their rivals a fifth consecutive defeat to round off NFL week seven. Fuente: BBC Sport.
